00044 PlayBufUGenInternal::PlayBufUGenInternal(Buffer const& buffer, UGen const& rate, UGen const& trig, UGen const& startPos, UGen const& loop) throw()
00045 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, buffer.getNumChannels() - 1),
00046     buffer_(buffer),
00047     bufferPos(0.0),
00048     lastTrig(0.f)
00049 {
00050     inputs[Rate] = rate;
00051     inputs[Trig] = trig;
00052     inputs[StartPos] = startPos;
00053     inputs[Loop] = loop;
00054 }

00062 void PlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00063 {
00064     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00065     double channelBufferPos;
00066     
00067     for(int channel = 0; channel < buffer_.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00068     {
00069         int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00070         const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00071         channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00072         float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00073         float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00074         float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00075         float* startPosSamples = inputs[StartPos].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00076         float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00077                 
00078         while(numSamplesToProcess && channelBufferPos < bufferSize)
00079         {               
00080             float thisTrig = *trigSamples++;
00081             
00082             if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00083                 channelBufferPos = 0.0;
00084             
00085             double startPos = *startPosSamples++;
00086             *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSampleUnchecked(channel, startPos + channelBufferPos);
00087             channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00088             
00089             if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f && channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00090                 channelBufferPos -= bufferSize;
00091             
00092             --numSamplesToProcess;
00093             lastTrig = thisTrig;
00094         }
00095         
00096         if(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00097             memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00098     }
00099     
00100     bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00101 }

00105 PlayBuf::PlayBuf(Buffer const& buffer, UGen const& rate, UGen const& trigger, UGen const& startPos, UGen const& loop) throw()
00106 {   
00107     // just mix the input ugens, they should be mono
00108     // mix() will just return the original UGen if it has only one channel anyway
00109     
00110     initInternal(buffer.getNumChannels());
00111     generateFromProxyOwner(new PlayBufUGenInternal(buffer, rate.mix(), trigger.mix(), startPos.mix(), loop.mix()));
00112 }
